title: Vintage Kodak Disc 4000 Camera, 1980s - Untested, Used
descriptionText: The Vintage KODAK Disc 4000 Camera from the 80s is a collectible item for film photography enthusiasts. This camera, part of the Kodak Disc series, features a unique disc format that allows for easy film loading and shooting. With its classic silver color and model number 4000, this camera embodies the nostalgia and style of film photography from the past. While this particular camera is untested, it holds the potential to capture timeless moments with its retro charm and functionality.
